author: Nick Carter (mrnicholasbcarter-code); code merged in PR 1185

acceptance.criterion: verdict doctor --json on installed main is green (status ok, no issues) with both gateway capabilities covered and healthy

first_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, issues, warnings, gateway: [.capability_bootstrap.capabilities[] | select(.capability_id | startswith("gateway.")) | {capability_id, status, health}]}'

fresh_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, issues, warnings, gateway: [.capability_bootstrap.capabilities[] | select(.capability_id | startswith("gateway.")) | {capability_id, status, health}]}'

stays_true_job: verdict-acceptance.timer runs `verdict doctor --json` every hour as its doctor check

setup_doctor.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, issues, warnings, gateway: [.capability_bootstrap.capabilities[] | select(.capability_id | startswith("gateway.")) | {capability_id, status, health}]}'
